- Success criteria: F1+ improvement on rerank, <200ms 95th percentile inference latency for the demo workload, clear cost estimates for production.

Proposed next steps (per our discussion):
1) Redwood to share Mutual Action Plan (attached) with suggested owners and dates.
2) BlueHarbor to confirm internal owner and available start week.
3) Security checklist Q&A to be routed to your security contact (Tom) — we included a short summary here.

Suggested owners & timeline in the MAP (can update):
- BlueHarbor owner: Leah Turner — target start: week of Jan 10
- Redwood owner: Marcus Lin — Redwood will run initial setup and demo in week 1
- Evaluation length: 2 weeks with a go/no-go decision by end of week 3

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_BlueHarbor_v1.pdf (attached) and link to editable MAP: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-map-v1
